office_does: A Court of Appeals judge hears and decides appeals from superior courts.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Incumbent Judge Erik D. Price, on the Court of Appeals since 2021, is unopposed.

candidates.summary: Court of Appeals judge since 2021 and former Thurston County Superior Court judge, unopposed for a six-year term.
highlights: Court of Appeals judge since 2021; Acting Chief Judge of Division II since 2026 [S1]
Thurston County Superior Court judge 2012-2021, including presiding judge [S1]
Chaired Adult Drug Court and the county's Pre-trial Justice Improvement Team [S1]
